entities.summary: Konstantin Vladimirovich Gorovikov is a Russian former professional ice hockey forward He most recently played for Dynamo Moscow of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was a member of the Russia men's national ice hockey team and won the 2008 IIHF World Championship and 2009 IIHF World Championship. He won the Gagarin Cup twice with Dynamo in 2012 and 2013.
